name: Elephant grass (our own design)
about: Made by tools/battle-models/asia (scenery). Metres; x east, y right, z up from the ground at its foot. Stands still: `sway` (0 to 1, point by point) is how far the wind moves each point; nothing else moves. Looks only: the battle's ground decides cover and passage. Paints: 0 grass, 1 grass_light, 2 grass_dry, 3 seed, 4 straw
